protocol.engine_time_origin: ViZDoom 1.3.0 clamps requested start0 to1. Record actual initial engine tic and use actual one-tic differences for gameplay clocks; never assume engine tic0. Record initial health before controls.
protocol.schedule: Two four-lane baseline calibration waves first, one per environment. Then environment order, seed order, and two candidate groups per seed. Rotate the seven-role order by seed ordinal modulo seven; append one baseline filler to the last group. Every lane is charged.
protocol.post_terminal: No respawn or further game action. Advance every resident neural lane through the remaining fixed horizon on dark RGB; label padding separately and exclude it from gameplay metrics. All24 wave-final checkpoints explicitly include padding.
protocol.evaluation: No updates or winner selection; report every role/seed, same-seed baseline contrasts and fitting-replica variation separately for each task.
protocol.primary_question: Hazard survival transfer; source-scenario kills and survival are separate concordance results, never pooled.

execution.outer_command_time_scope: Native time -p wraps the exact CLI, including preflight, allocation, evaluation, evidence IO and cleanup; excludes SSH transport and independent later audits.
execution.recording: No RGB video was stored. Live trace controls, hashes, game observers and checkpoints exist; no comparison video has been created.

control_diagnostic.scope: Read-only live applied-action diagnostics from completed summary traces; padding, calibration and fillers excluded. Means are per-live-tic within each seed; controls do not prove spatial progress.

initial_checkpoint_audit.scope: read-only independent all-four initial checkpoint artifact, dtype/shape/finite-array and fixed metadata comparison to pinned original; no neural propagation

final_native_full.envelope_scope: entry through tests, release pressure and physical audit; result IO excluded

final_native_boundary.envelope_scope: entry through tests, release pressure and physical audit; result IO excluded

validation.portable_full_scope: Single ordinary portable suite at initial Task3 source; not final source41 full-suite proof. Final bounded covering tests and final-source full native validation are separately recorded.

audit_v01.failure: Dictionary configuration stored in checkpoint metadata and frozen evidence was compared to the separate reference model identity digest. Diagnostic error only; original helper and failed console preserved.

audit_v02.correction: Exact checkpoint/frozen/reference dictionary comparison plus independent canonical JSON SHA256 against the pinned reference digest; no scientific rerun or relaxed guard.

lease_release.scope: read-only nonblocking exclusive lease acquisition after observed scientific process exit

fitting_evidence.scope: read-only byte comparison of 120 previous traces and 124 previous checkpoints against independently published audit pins; no historical replay or new biological validation
limits: This is not a byte manifest of every original study file. The seven frozen candidate vectors are separately rehashed by the live-transfer audit.
Live RGB pixels were not stored; their fresh-source path and hashes are checked through code, fixtures and reproducibility, not independent pixel reconstruction.
Full runtime setup ordering and charge-before-install combine tested source contracts with durable final records; a final ledger alone is not a replay of every write.
Envelope, RGB-loop, batch, native, GPU, wait, game and checkpoint clocks overlap; they must not be added together or described as one GPU-only speed.
Four seeds and two fitting replicas remain exploratory; random controls have unequal fitting compute and perturbation magnitude.
